# chessgator

> Free chess coach. Play a human-like Maia bot in your browser. Stockfish explains your moves. No accounts. Engines run locally.

chessgator is a free static website at https://chessgator.com. There are no accounts and no server-side analysis. You play chess against Maia, a human-like neural network (Elo 1100–1900), in the browser. After each human move, Stockfish classifies the move, explains the idea, and can show a better line. Maia, Stockfish, and ONNX Runtime run on the visitor's device via WebAssembly. The first visit downloads about 30 MB. Games stay in the browser.

## Pages

- [Home](https://chessgator.com/): What the site is, what Maia is, how the coach works, and a short comparison with Chess.com and Lichess
- [Play](https://chessgator.com/game): The board — play Maia with local Stockfish coaching, no sign-up
- [Play levels](https://chessgator.com/play): Maia strength ladder from Elo 1100 to 1900
- [Play beginner](https://chessgator.com/play/beginner): Start a beginner-strength Maia game (Elo 1200)
- [Maia](https://chessgator.com/maia): What Maia is and why it plays like a human
- [Learn](https://chessgator.com/learn): How the coach explains moves
- [Openings](https://chessgator.com/openings): Lichess CC0 encyclopedia of ECO-classified openings
- [Openings by ECO](https://chessgator.com/openings/eco/a): Browse openings by ECO volume (A–E)
- [Openings by first move](https://chessgator.com/openings/first-move/e4): Browse openings that start with 1. e4 and other first moves
- [Games](https://chessgator.com/games): Annotated famous games you can take over against Maia
- [About](https://chessgator.com/about): How a session works and engine credits
- [FAQ](https://chessgator.com/faq): Play Maia outside Lichess, free move explanations, chess vs a computer with no sign-up
- [Privacy](https://chessgator.com/privacy): No accounts; games stay on the device
- [Notices](https://chessgator.com/notices): Licenses for Maia, Stockfish, and ONNX Runtime

## Notes for crawlers

- No user accounts or authentication
- Engines run in the visitor's browser (WASM); analysis is not computed on the server
- The site is a static Next.js export
- Brand name is chessgator; people search for human-like chess bots, playing Maia, and a free chess coach, not the brand
